description:
Ground-floor for Phase 2. New umbrella app \`octo_pi_agent\` with:

- mix.exs: depends on \`{:octo_pi_ai, in_umbrella: true}\`; telemetry.
- OctoPi.Agent.Application: Supervisor that starts Task.Supervisor
  (loop tasks), Task.Supervisor (tool exec), Registry (subscribers),
  and the per-app telemetry handler.
- Contract types (no logic, just structs + @types):
  - %OctoPi.Agent.Session.State{} — fields per port-map §1
  - AgentMessage union (User/Assistant/ToolResult/Custom)
  - AgentEvent union (AgentStart/End, TurnStart/End, MessageStart/Update/End, ToolExecutionStart/Update/End)
  - %OctoPi.Agent.Tool{} + %OctoPi.Agent.Tool.Result{}
  - %OctoPi.Agent.PendingMessageQueue{} — just the struct; implementation in opi-hgb... actually z1d.5
  - Abort ref type
- @behaviour OctoPi.Agent.Tool.Handler (the execute callback)
- @behaviour OctoPi.Agent.Transport (stream/3 signature)
- A toy Echo tool module in test/support/ that implements the handler
  and returns its input as content — useful throughout subsequent tickets.

TDD: just construct the structs in tests, assert shapes. No runtime
behaviour.

Files:
- apps/octo_pi_agent/{mix.exs, .formatter.exs, .gitignore}
- apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/{application.ex, message.ex, event.ex, tool.ex, session/state.ex, transport.ex, abort_ref.ex}
- apps/octo_pi_agent/test/support/echo_tool.ex

See docs/port-map/agent.md §1, §3, §8 for specifics.
title: Scaffold octo_pi_agent app + contract types + Tool behaviour + Echo sample
